title: Choosing film for a temporary display

documents.title: Display work order
documents.text:
The lobby panel will be covered for the spring exhibit only. Use film with removable backing; permanent backing is approved only for the rear workshop sign, not the lobby. The lobby panel is 58 cm wide. Its two edges require one extra centimetre of film on each side, so the roll width must allow for both margins.

The original layout required 10 metres. The designer has added two metres of printed material to the same layout. Prepare the full length from a single roll: a join would cross the middle of a word. The length column shows what remains usable after removing damaged sections. Do not add the damaged sections back into your estimate.
documents.textZh:
大廳展板只在春季展覽期間貼膜。請使用可移除背膠；永久背膠只核准用於後方工作間的標誌，不適用於大廳。大廳展板寬 58 公分，兩側各需多留一公分，因此卷材寬度必須涵蓋兩側餘量。

原版面需要 10 公尺。設計師已在同一版面增加兩公尺的印刷內容。全長須用同一卷裁出，因為接縫會穿過一個詞。長度欄列出扣除受損區段後仍可使用的長度。估算時請勿把受損區段加回去。
